# Which hearing aid sales actually make money?

> Free calculator for hearing aid clinics and audiologists: what each hearing aid sale really earns after device cost, trial-period returns, follow-up visits, commission, card and plan fees and clinician time. Margin by sale type, price for a target margin, private pay vs plan, break-even sales. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
